paragraph: [The 2025 state budget allots Kz 23 billion to the tax authority AGT](<https://pti.ao/oge-transformacao-digital-da-agt-vai-custar-23-mil-milhoes-kz-ao-estado/>) for its SIGT/SIIAT digital transformation project. [In September 2026 CIAT authors described AGT's Integrated Tax Management System (SIGT)](<https://www.ciat.org/modernisation-of-general-tax-administration-over-the-last-10-years-a-tax-and-customs-analysis/?lang=en>) as meant to take tax procedures off paper, from registration and returns to payment. [In July 2026 AGT ruled that taxes are, as a general rule, paid electronically through its Portal do Contribuinte](<https://valoreconomico.co.ao/artigo/fim-do-papel-agt-exige-via-digital-para-pagamento-de-impostos-e-reclamacoes>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxpayers can file returns online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

[In November 2023 the revenue authority (OBR) said large and medium taxpayers file returns online](<https://abpinfo.bi/2023/12/01/lancement-officiel-des-activites-de-celebration-de-la-8eme-edition-de-la-journee-dediee-aux-contribuables/>). They have done so on its Umutangakori portal since 1 August 2023. [The OBR also said taxes are paid online there, with receipts issued the same way](<https://abpinfo.bi/2023/12/01/lancement-officiel-des-activites-de-celebration-de-la-8eme-edition-de-la-journee-dediee-aux-contribuables/>). In the last twelve months, [Burundi Times reported in January 2026 that the OBR had begun implementing E-KORI](<https://www.burunditimes.com/burundi-revenue-authority-rolls-out-e-kori-digital-tax-platform/>). It is a new platform for online declaration and payment, with World Bank support. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[On 23 May 2024 the Direction générale des impôts launched its e-services portal in Cotonou](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/le-benin-permet-desormais-aux-contribuables-et-aux-particuliers-de-declarer-et-de-payer-leurs-impots-en-ligne/>), where small businesses and individuals declare income online. [A circular of 16 September 2025 made tax stamps and deed registration online only](<https://africaho.bj/article/benin-la-dgi-dematerialise-les-timbres-fiscaux-et-lenregistrement-des-actes/>), with payment through e-services.impots.bj. [Through the SIGIBé system taxpayers pay online, mostly by mobile money, and the tax directorate's 2025 report puts electronic payments above 96% for most taxes](<https://ictd.ac/general/benins-e-tax-rollout-small-businesses-digital-public-infrastructure/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing of returns is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[The tax directorate's eSINTAX platform has been online since April 2018 for large and mid-size enterprises](<https://burkina24.com/2019/12/30/communique-du-directeur-general-des-impots-4/>). [Online payment became compulsory for large enterprises from 1 January 2020](<https://burkina24.com/2019/12/30/communique-du-directeur-general-des-impots-4/>). [The directorate also said they have had to file through the portal since 1 January 2019](<https://burkina24.com/2019/12/30/communique-du-directeur-general-des-impots-4/>). In the last twelve months, [leFaso.net reported in November 2026 that the eSINTAX JAVA portal lets taxpayers file declarations and pay taxes remotely](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article150547>). No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[In July 2025 BURS board chairperson Lesedi Senatla urged taxpayers to file 2025 individual returns through the e-services portal and Mtax app](<https://dailynews.gov.bw/news-detail/87418>). The season ran from 1 July to 30 September 2025. [In July 2024 Commissioner General Janet Makgolo said 77% of the 38,000 individual returns filed in the previous financial year were submitted online](<https://www.gabzfm.com/post/burs-encourages-online-filing-after-falling-short-of-tax-return-target>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

[The tax directorate (DGID) launched e-Tax for online returns on 24 March 2025](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/2503-126985-la-centrafrique-lance-officiellement-e-tax-sa-plateforme-de-paiement-d-impots-en-ligne>), and e-Tax has taken online payment of taxes since then. [In a communiqué of 7 August 2025 the finance minister required large taxpayers to file on e-Tax](<https://ecomatin.net/fiscalite-bangui-menace-de-sanctionner-les-grandes-entreprises-qui-boudent-la-plateforme-e-tax>). [Those who did not faced systematic audits from early September 2025](<https://ecomatin.net/fiscalite-bangui-menace-de-sanctionner-les-grandes-entreprises-qui-boudent-la-plateforme-e-tax>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No share of returns filed online has been found. [In the same communiqué the minister said more than half of the firms concerned still did not use the platform](<https://ecomatin.net/fiscalite-bangui-menace-de-sanctionner-les-grandes-entreprises-qui-boudent-la-plateforme-e-tax>).

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether tax returns can be filed online in Côte d'Ivoire. Nothing has been found either that says returns are filed and taxes paid on paper. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source from the past three years names an online tax filing or payment service for the country. Absent would need a source from the past three years that says tax returns are filed and taxes paid on paper.

[LeFisk reported in August 2026 that the tax directorate takes returns online through ATOM](<https://lefisk.cm/blog/enregistrement-actes-en-ligne-dgi-cameroun-registrations-guide>), and that it has since put the registration of deeds on a new platform. [Registration duties on public-procurement contracts are assessed and paid online on registrations.dgi.cm, by Mobile Money, Orange Money or a DGI code](<https://lefisk.cm/blog/enregistrement-actes-en-ligne-dgi-cameroun-registrations-guide>). Only three of the 120 deeds listed were open. [Tele-declaration began in 2016 for the largest taxpayers and was extended in 2022 to the local and individual taxpayer centres](<https://leconomie.info/digitalisation-fiscale-au-cameroun-la-direction-generale-des-impots-opere-sa-mue/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[Finance minister Doudou Fwamba said on RTNC that VAT tele-declaration (e-filing) has been generalised at the Direction generale des impots](<https://7sur7.cd/index.php/2026/09/03/rdc-les-recettes-mensuelles-de-la-tva-passent-de-1237-plus-de-1414-millions-grace-aux>), according to a report of September 2026. [He also said the E-Finance programme, structured with Huawei, mobilises over US$150m](<https://7sur7.cd/index.php/2026/09/03/rdc-les-recettes-mensuelles-de-la-tva-passent-de-1237-plus-de-1414-millions-grace-aux>). It funds applications including the tax directorate's ERP. [He listed the generalisation among the public-finance reforms carried out in August 2026](<https://lepotentiel.cd/2026/08/26/2597801/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes to be paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

[L'Economie reports that since 3 August 2026 taxpayers pay taxes and levies online through the Fouta national switch](<https://leconomie.info/congo-le-paiement-des-impots-et-taxes-bascule-en-ligne/>), after declaring on E-Tax. [In November 2024 MTN Congo said an e-tax declaration made on impots.gouv.cg can be paid by MTN Mobile Money](<https://www.mtn.cg/momo/particuliers/e-pay-for-e-tax-e-douane/>). In the last twelve months, [the finance minister said FCFA 94 billion of tax was collected through e-Tax via FOUTA](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/fr/articles/questions-orales-avec-d%C3%A9bat-AN_171126>). That covers 1 June to 16 November 2026. [The ministry says FOUTA is being deployed in three phases](<https://www.finances.gouv.cg/fr/articles/pr%C3%A9sentation-du-switch-mon%C3%A9tique-national-onec-c_030726>). All taxpayers are due by the end of 2026. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[The Directorate General of Taxes launched a three-day workshop on 15 April 2026, funded by AFD through PAGFSI](<https://finances.gouv.km/actualite_post/atelier-dgi-au-retaj-sur-la-validation-du-cadre-juridique-des-teleprocedures-fiscales-2026/>). [It was to prepare the progressive deployment of tax e-filing (télédéclaration) and e-payment (télépaiement) under the 2026 finance law](<https://finances.gouv.km/actualite_post/atelier-dgi-au-retaj-sur-la-validation-du-cadre-juridique-des-teleprocedures-fiscales-2026/>). [The Directorate's own report says the workshop was also to validate the legal framework](<https://web.archive.org/web/20260520073604/http://dgi.gouv.km/fr/actualite.php?article_id=93>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says tax returns can be filed online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

[In May 2024 the tax directorate (DNRE) said tax returns are submitted electronically through its portal](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/web/dnre/-/funcionamento-do-portal>). It moved the 2024 deadline from 31 May to 14 June after an outage was cleared. [From 11 February 2019 the DNRE and the Casa do Cidadao offered online payment of taxes by bank card on the citizen portal](<https://www.mf.gov.cv/web/dnre/-/dnre-apresenta-novo-meio-de-pagamento-de-impostos-online>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes to be paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

[A World Bank status report put the share of tax returns filed and paid on time through ITAS at 0 as of 9 January 2026](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099012726115520907/pdf/P180696-28ecf2f4-34e9-4559-9695-f14bd83f8798.pdf>). [Its target is 70% by December 2029](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099012726115520907/pdf/P180696-28ecf2f4-34e9-4559-9695-f14bd83f8798.pdf>). [The World Bank's US$20m Economic and Financial Governance Project includes tax administration modernisation and revenue administration digitalisation](<https://projects.worldbank.org/en/projects-operations/project-detail/P180696>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says tax returns can be filed online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

[In May 2026 the tax directorate (DGI) extended its Jibayatic tele-declaration and tele-payment system to all local tax offices](<https://algeriezoom.com/impots-algerie-5-changements-generalisation-jibayatic/>), under DGI instruction 31/2026 of 6 May 2026. In the last twelve months, the mandate to file electronically grew: until that instruction only large-enterprise (DGE) taxpayers had to file electronically. [The instruction also makes it mandatory for real-profit regime taxpayers and simplified non-commercial professions](<https://algeriezoom.com/impots-algerie-5-changements-generalisation-jibayatic/>). [From May 2026 taxpayers of tax centres, proximity centres and inspections can pay taxes remotely through Jibayatic](<https://algeriezoom.com/impots-algerie-5-changements-generalisation-jibayatic/>). [The DGI said in July 2026 that payment through Jibayatic is by CIB or Edahabia card or bank transfer](<https://ouest-tribune.dz/direction-generale-des-impots-lancement-du-paiement-electronique-a-distance-des-impots-via-le-portail-jibayatic/>).

[Egyptian Tax Authority head Rasha Abdel Aal said in August 2026 that taxpayers have started creating accounts and submitting returns electronically](<https://www.fintechgate.net/250244>). [In October 2025 the authority's head said employers compute wage tax on its unified platform](<https://eta.gov.eg/ar/news/mnzwmt-twhyd-ass-wmayyr-ahtsab-drybt-alajwr-walmrtbat-ysahm-fy-thqyq-aldalt-aldrybyt>), by payroll integration, spreadsheet upload or manual entry. [Finance minister Ahmed Kouchouk said real estate transactions tax can be paid electronically by bank cards or direct-debit cards](<https://www.fintechgate.net/250244>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

No stage is set. The only item found is [ERITAS](<https://www.afdb.org/sites/default/files/documents/projects-and-operations/eritrea_-_strengthening_tax_administration_project_estap_-_project_appraisal_report.pdf>), named in an African Development Bank project appraisal report. Nothing found since October 2023 says whether tax returns can be filed online in Eritrea. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found shows an e-filing system procured, piloted or being built. Preparing would need an integrated tax administration or e-filing system procured, piloted or being built.

[A January 2024 ICTD paper examines the adoption rate trend of the e-filing system among large and medium taxpayers](<https://www.ictd.ac/publication/e-tax-system-adoption-tax-compliance-ethiopia>). [In January 2024 the Ministry of Revenues announced it would extend its e-tax system across tax bureaus, Addis Fortune reports](<https://addisfortune.news/ministry-embarks-on-e-tax-services>). In the last twelve months, [on 8 October 2026 the Ministry of Revenue re-advertised for a Technical Lead/Chief Architect for the Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS)](<https://www.getchereta.com/tender/85995>). The World Bank finances the post. [The Executive Budget Proposal for 2024/25 lists an ITAS capital project at ETB 26,671,900](<https://www.mofed.gov.et/media/filer_public/4f/f4/4ff40d12-0261-4680-9e1a-06dc7b964cd8/executive_budget_proposal_efy_2017_-202425__budget_year_goe_federal_budget_proclamation-proposal.xlsx>). No source found since October 2023 says taxes can be paid electronically through the tax authority's system. Operating would need taxes to be paid online, by bank transfer or by mobile money, through the tax authority's system.

The tax directorate [announced an e-tax portal for online tax returns and payment on 18 August 2025](<http://gouvernement.ga/2025/08/18/etax-direction-generale-des-impots>). [Since 10 July 2025 small taxpayers can declare and pay by phone through e-Tax](<https://www.gabonreview.com/e-tax-le-gabon-passe-au-paiement-mobile-des-impots/>). In the last twelve months, [eTax was being brought into the Gabon Connect portal in October 2026](<https://dgi.ga/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Flyer-Gabon-Connect-%E2%80%93-Rencontre-FEG.pdf>), the directorate's flyer says. [A single online monthly salary declaration opened there on 21 October for the 440 firms of the large-enterprises directorate](<https://dgi.ga/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Flyer-Gabon-Connect-%E2%80%93-Rencontre-FEG.pdf>). No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[The GRA is deploying its Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) as a single platform covering registration, filing, payment and accounting](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/gras-itas-and-other-digital-platforms-set-to-strengthen-tax-compliance/>). [In August 2026 MyJoyOnline reported that the ITAS pilot covers filing and payment of PAYE, VAT, VAT Withholding and Withholding VAT for selected taxpayers](<https://www.myjoyonline.com/understanding-ghanas-new-integrated-tax-administration-system-itas/>). [Graphic Online reports that over 400 taxpayers from the Accra West Area Office were onboarded in phase one, with large taxpayers next](<https://graphiconline.com/news/general-news/ghana-news-gra-activates-new-tax-administration-platform-over-400-taxpayers-onboarded.html>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

In the last twelve months, [We Are Tech reported in May 2026 that the government has launched eTax for filing tax returns online](<https://www.wearetech.africa/fr/fils/actualites/tech/la-guinee-lance-neuf-chantiers-numeriques-pour-moderniser-l-administration>). It also takes tax payments online. [In September 2020 the Budget Minister said pilot firms had begun filing on the eTax portal, launched that month](<https://guineenews.org/2020/09/14/innovation-dans-la-gouvernance-financiere-le-premier-ministre-kassory-lance-le-portail-e-tax/?amp=1>). They had declared and paid GNF 45 billion through it. The 2020 figures cover pilot firms only, and the May 2026 report gives no count of users. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[The GRA Commissioner General said in June 2026 that the new Integrated Tax Administration System (ITAS) will let taxpayers register, file returns, pay and access services online](<https://www.voicegambia.com/2026/06/17/gra-says-new-itas-will-transform-tax-administration-in-the-gambia/>). [A joint Ministry of Finance and GRA press release says the World Bank-supported ITAS is being implemented](<https://www.gra.gm/news/4f0f3845-b049-11f0-b086-029254d29bb1>). [An Arabsoft and Tunisie Micro-Informatique consortium was selected at USD 7,270,192.20 after the first awardee went bankrupt](<https://www.gra.gm/news/4f0f3845-b049-11f0-b086-029254d29bb1>). [That first contract, signed with Sogema Technologies in May 2024, was for a web-based ITAS with online filing to replace GAMTAXNET](<https://standard.gm/gra-signs-agreement-to-improve-efficiency-transparency/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says tax returns can be filed online. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

[In July 2024 O Democrata GB reported that Kontaktu, the platform of the tax directorate (DGCI), lets taxpayers declare their taxes online](<https://www.odemocratagb.com/?p=49407>), and pay by bank transfer, Orange Money and Mobile Money. [The IMF says Kontaktu, an electronic filing and payment platform, was launched in 2021](<https://www.imf.org/en/publications/high-level-summary-technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/30/guinea-bissau-further-improvements-in-tax-compliance-548436>). [An IMF report published in April 2024 says all large and medium taxpayers have had to file electronically since March 2022](<https://www.imf.org/en/publications/high-level-summary-technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/30/guinea-bissau-further-improvements-in-tax-compliance-548436>). [It counted six electronic payment options in April 2024, up from none in March 2022](<https://www.imf.org/en/publications/high-level-summary-technical-assistance-reports/issues/2024/04/30/guinea-bissau-further-improvements-in-tax-compliance-548436>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No share of returns filed online has been found, and the mandate found is dated March 2022.

Kenya's revenue authority runs the iTax portal, where [VAT returns have been filed since mid-August 2026](<https://www.the-star.co.ke/opinion/star-blogs/2026-09-01-monari-when-itax-fails-the-taxpayer-still-pays>) after the offline Excel template was dropped, The Star reported. In the last twelve months, [export values from the customs system have been prefilled in the VAT return since May 2026](<https://www.kra.go.ke/news-center/public-notices/2368-integration-of-the-export-process-in-icms-with-the-vat-return-in-itax>). The Commissioner General said returns can be filed [through a WhatsApp service run by an AI chatbot](<https://www.kra.go.ke/news-center/press-release/2362-kra-surpasses-ksh-2-trillion-revenue-milestone,-records11-4-growth-in-nine-months>). They can also be filed [by USSD code](<https://www.kra.go.ke/news-center/press-release/2329-president-ruto-hails-kra%E2%80%99s-ai-led-reforms,-honours-taxpayers-for-upholding-compliancepresident-ruto-hails-kra%E2%80%99s-ai-led-reforms,-honours-taxpayers-for-upholding-compliance>). [Capital gains tax is paid through iTax](<https://anoadvocates.com/insights/stamp-duty-payments-simplified-by-ardhipay>), a law firm wrote in July 2024. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[The LRA said in August 2025 that its LITAS system handles online filing, assessments and payments](<https://revenue.lra.gov.lr/lra-trains-staff-on-new-digital-tax-payment-system/>). [In April 2026 the LRA's head of systems said taxpayers generate payment slips and pay in real time on LITAS](<https://revenue.lra.gov.lr/lra-hosts-first-digital-symposium-to-showcase-technology-driving-tax-compliance-and-payment-systems/>). [In August 2026 the LRA's plan said LITAS return processing had been rolled out to one Tax Business Office](<https://revenue.lra.gov.lr/wp-content/uploads/2026/04/LRA-CSP-2025-Final.pdf>), and tabled all modules rolled out to all offices as the expected result. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[In December 2025 the Tax Authority announced that the Unified Tax System was officially in operation](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=346934&lang=ar>). [It said digital platforms would be launched during 2026 under its digital transformation plan](<https://lana.gov.ly/post.php?id=346934&lang=ar>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says taxpayers can file returns online, or pay taxes electronically, through the Unified Tax System. Establishing would need taxpayers to be able to file returns online for at least one core tax.

[In June 2025 Revenue Services Lesotho said taxpayers register on its eTax platform, log in with a username and password and file their returns there](<https://www.rsl.org.ls/sites/default/files/2025-06/Guide%20on%20Tax%20Registration.pdf>). [Its guide says returns for CIT, IIT, RIIT, T&E, VAT and PAYE can be submitted online](<https://www.rsl.org.ls/sites/default/files/2025-02/Guide%20on%20E-Taxation%20Platform%20%28E-Filing%29.pdf>). [It says taxes can be paid through the e-Payments platform by mobile money (EcoCash and M-Pesa) and by bank EFT](<https://www.rsl.org.ls/sites/default/files/2025-02/Guide%20on%20E-Taxation%20Platform%20%28E-Filing%29.pdf>). [LAA's Director General says the Automatic Compliance Project is in use, with RSL retrieving PAYE files as early as August 2024](<https://newsdayonline.co.ls/rsl-doubles-down-on-enhancing-tax-compliance/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.

[In 2025 taxpayers filed 5,031,004 returns online through SIMPL, the DGI says](<https://fr.le360.ma/economie/impots-914-des-recettes-fiscales-encaissees-par-telepaiement-en-2025_UYH2TYM6ENA5HCQIPRGMWZML44/>), and 91.4% of tax revenue was paid online. In 2017 the DGI [made electronic filing and payment mandatory for all firms](<https://article19.ma/accueil/archives/35106>), except those on the flat-rate regime. In the last twelve months, [Decree 2.25.862 of 27 November 2025 required non-resident suppliers of digital services to register on the DGI's platform](<https://ecoactu.ma/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/decret-pour-la-TVA-sur-les-services-a-distance-au-Maroc-fournis-par-des-prestataires-non-residents-Art-115-Bis-du-CGI.pdf>). They must file VAT returns and pay electronically. [In May 2026 the DGI opened a platform called Taxation on Digital Services](<https://fr.hespress.com/489385-publicite-meta-applique-la-tva-au-maroc-des-octobre.html>). No share of returns filed online has been found. The mandate found in the last three years covers non-resident suppliers of digital services only.

[In September 2025 finance minister Rindra Rabarinirinarison said the new Integrated Tax Administration System (SAFI) takes returns and payments online at any hour](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-rindra-rabarinirinarison-minister-of-economy-and-finance-of-madagascar>). [The tax administration's steering committee reported SAFI tested and ready for production from the end of September 2025](<https://new.moov.mg/actualite/106644-modernisation-fiscale-la-plateforme-safi-prete-pour-la-mise-en-production>). [SAFI went into production after the committee met on 18 September 2025, the tax administration said](<https://cabinet-fenitra.mg/actualites/safi-cap-sur-le-deploiement-effectif-a-madagascar/>). [The minister also said the e-Hetra system for declaring and paying taxes online has been extended nationwide](<https://kaori-media.com/posts/interview-with-hon-rindra-rabarinirinarison-minister-of-economy-and-finance-of-madagascar>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 says online filing is mandatory or used for half or more of returns. Mature would need online filing made mandatory for some taxpayers, or half or more of returns filed online.
